quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Kure's 2026-2030 latter basic plan under the 2021-2030 fifth long-term plan, annual component-project/KPI route, FY2026 initial budget, and FY2024 prior-period settlement. It preserves plan-version and budget-state boundaries and makes no independent achievement, causal, or comparison judgment.
